## Description
Summary of the changes made and the problem being solved.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring / optimization (no behavioral changes)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] Tested locally with `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`
- [ ] Tested release build with `./gradlew assembleRelease`
- [ ] Code adheres to the established style conventions
- [ ] Relevant documentation updated
